title.en: Deputy Registrar to Exercise Powers of Registrar

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 1 条。

text.en:
Control of Manufacture Act
(Chapter 57, Section 4(2))
Deputy Registrar to Exercise Powers of Registrar
N 2
G.N. No. S 69/1990
REVISED EDITION 1990
(25th March 1992)
[1st February 1990]
The Minister for Trade and Industry has authorised the Deputy Registrar of Manufacturers to exercise and perform all or any of the powers and duties conferred and imposed on the Registrar of Manufacturers.
[S 69/90]
